title: PILLAR Act
committees: Senate Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs
last_action: Received in the Senate, read twice, and referred to the Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs after passing the House.
status: Passed House; referred to Senate committee
summary: Would reauthorize CISA's State and Local Cybersecurity Grant Program and expressly extend grant planning, inventories, vulnerability assessment, threat mitigation, and resilience work to information and operational-technology systems that use AI.
committee_dynamics: The House passed the bill by voice vote. Its AI provisions are part of a broader cybersecurity-grant reauthorization, making the measure relevant but adjacent to the tracker's central developer- and model-safety focus.
advance_rationale: House passage creates a credible path, but the bill still requires Senate committee and floor action.
verification_level: House passage, Senate referral, and current bill text checked against official congressional sources.

claim_provenance.note: Tracker classification and synthesis based on the House-passed text.
